You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

jobs.description:

 How You’ll Help Us Connect The World
 As an AI Automation Engineer, you will design, build, and run the LLM-powered and agentic systems that are changing how we work. You will ship production AI services that automate triage, classification, and decision support for our operations and support teams, and build the AI-driven SDLC tooling that makes our engineers faster—from custom coding-assistant skills and agents to automated evaluation and guardrails.
This is a hands-on role where you are expected to pair strong backend engineering with practical GenAI skills. You will be based in Bangalore, Karnataka.
 You Will Make An Impact By
 Designing, building, and deploying LLM-powered and agentic workflows that automate triage, classification, and decision support for operational and support teams.
 Developing production-grade backend services in Python - REST APIs and async pipelines—with solid prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and evaluation practices.
 Partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, well-documented AI solutions.
 Building and maintaining AI-driven SDLC automation such as spec-to-code generation, AI-assisted code review, and automated test generation embedded in everyday engineering workflows.

 Monitoring and improving model quality, reliability, latency, and cost through observability, guardrails, and feedback loops.
 Maximizing token yield without compromising quality by delivering more useful, accepted output per token spent, with every optimization backed by evals that prove quality holds.
 Optimizing multi-agent workflows for speed, cost, and token usage through context management, parallel execution, and prompt optimization.
 Cutting token waste with tight context curation, prompt caching, right-sized model routing, and concise structured outputs.
 Tracking token efficiency as a first-class metric including cost per successful task and tokens per accepted output while setting token budgets for agentic workflows.
 Owning the delivery lifecycle in a DevSecOps environment (CI/CD, containerization, and automated testing from first commit to production)
 Applying secure-by-default practices to every service you ship, including secrets management, access control, and dependency scanning.

Teams use LowerPlane to generate customizable policies, automate vendor security questionnaire responses, track controls and readiness, and prepare for audits with structured workflows. LowerPlane’s mission is to lower the barrier to enterprise-grade trust so organizations can move through audits faster, build customer confidence earlier, and scale securely.

The Full Stack Engineer will design, develop, and maintain end-to-end web applications that power LowerPlane’s compliance automation platform. Daily responsibilities include building and optimizing front-end interfaces, implementing robust back-end services and APIs, integrating data sources, and ensuring performance, security, and reliability across the stack. The role involves collaborating closely with product, design, and compliance teams to translate requirements into scalable features, writing clean and tested code, and participating in code reviews. The engineer will also help improve development workflows, contribute to architectural decisions, and support ongoing monitoring, debugging, and enhancement of production systems.

Ship the web app and integrations our customers use every day

Chennai, India

Full-time

**About the position**
----------------------

Advertflair builds AI-powered visual production for brands that need thousands of consistent, on-brand images without running a photo studio. Our platform turns product photos and 3D assets into catalog and campaign imagery for fashion, apparel and fine-art logistics companies, and our Chennai studio (ISO 27001:2022 certified) runs the production behind it. We are a small team shipping fast, and this role is hands-on from week one.

As an AI Developer you will build the product layer around our models: the web app, APIs and store integrations that let customers upload products, run bulk jobs and download finished visuals.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build and improve features in our React and Node.js web application, including bulk upload and processing, team collaboration and billing
* Integrate AI services and our own pipelines through clean, well-documented APIs
* Build integrations with e-commerce platforms such as Shopify
* Write tests and fix bugs quickly; keep the product stable as usage grows
* Work with product and design to turn user feedback into shipped improvements
* Follow secure coding practices; we handle client assets under ISO 27001 controls

**Requirements**
----------------

* 1-2 years of professional experience in full-stack or front-end development
* Good knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, React and a Node.js or Python backend
* Experience with REST APIs and a SQL database (Postgres preferred)
* Comfortable using AI coding assistants and integrating LLM or image-model APIs
* Familiar with Git and code review
* Clear communication and a habit of shipping small, working pieces

Ready to apply? Fill in the application form below with your details and a link to your work or LinkedIn profile. We read every application.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 3 - GenAI
jobs.description:
About Bidgely
 Bidgely is a Silicon Valley AI company transforming how utilities and their customers understand and manage energy. The UtilityAI platform converts smart meter data into appliance-level insights, while Agentic CX brings GenAI assistants to utility chat, voice IVR, and customer service. Leading utilities across North America, Europe, and Asia rely on Bidgely. Our Bengaluru engineering center is a certified Great Place to Work.
The Role
We are seeking a senior software engineer to build and scale Energy Assistant, our GenAI assistant embedded in utility web portals and mobile apps. Energy Assistant answers customers' questions about usage, bills, appliances, rate plans, and savings through a multi-agent system built on LangGraph, leveraging Bidgely's energy data with tool calls and deterministic calculations. You will own major components end to end, help shape the architecture, and elevate the engineering standards of the team. This is a hands-on role working closely with GenAI engineering, platform, QA/SDET, and product teams.
Key Responsibilities
 Design and build production multi-agent systems: supervisor/router and specialist agents, LangGraph workflows, tool calling, conversation memory, and checkpointing. 
 Build typed tool contracts and data-access layers over Bidgely APIs to ensure the LLM explains results instead of generating numbers. 
 Develop RAG pipelines for utility tariff and knowledge retrieval, with tenant-isolated embeddings and retrieval. 
 Manage latency, reliability, and cost: caching, prewarming, retries, circuit breakers, and model routing across small and large model tiers. 
 Implement guardrails for prompt injection, scope control, authorization, tenant isolation, and data management. 
 Build observability and evaluation hooks with LangSmith, and collaborate with SDETs on evaluation datasets, regression suites, and release criteria. 
 Debug agent failures in production using traces, logs, and metrics, and drive root-cause fixes. 
 Support streaming (WebSocket/SSE) and widget integration with front-end teams. 
 Lead design and code reviews, set engineering standards, and mentor SDE1 and SDE2 engineers. 
 Communicate designs, trade-offs, and progress to engineering, product, and leadership. 
 Requirements
 6–10 years of software engineering experience, including at least 1–2 years building and shipping LLM or GenAI features in production. 
 Strong Python skills and good working knowledge of Java. 
 Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar agent orchestration frameworks. 
 Experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock), prompt design, tool/function calling, and structured outputs. 
 Experience building RAG systems with embeddings and vector stores (e.g., pgvector). 
 Strong backend and API design skills, with experience building scalable, low-latency services. 
 Experience with AWS, containers (EKS), PostgreSQL, Redis, and CI/CD. 
 Experience with evals, LLM-as-judge, or AI observability tools such as LangSmith. 
 Strong system design, analytical, and communication skills. 
 Nice to Have
 Experience with time-series, IoT, or smart meter data, or the energy and utilities domain. 
 Experience with voice or IVR GenAI products. 
 Experience with multi-tenant SaaS solutions, security, and data-privacy enhancements for LLM applications. 
 Tech You Will Work With
Python, Java, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, RAG, pgvector, tool calling, …

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.8B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About The Role**

The Finance Experience Team builds the foundation and platform for Rippling’s Finance Suite. Our mission is to make every Finance product feel like one coherent, intelligent suite—not a collection of separate tools. We own the common experiences, workflows, controls, data platforms, and AI-assisted capabilities used across Spend, Accounting, and related Finance products.

**What You Will Do**

* Build high-quality web and mobile experiences spanning Finance Overview, Tasks, People, Settings, notifications, and suite-wide navigation.
* Develop shared application platforms and public APIs that enable Finance product teams to build consistent, scalable features quickly.
* Engineer foundational data experiences, including configurable grids, advanced filtering and sorting, bulk actions, reconciliation workflows, and rich transaction line items.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer III
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

There’s nothing like a career at Entain India. We’re the technology powerhouse helping Entain – a world leader in sports and gaming – create products and experiences used by millions of customers across the globe.

You’ll thrive here, whether you’re a product owner who wants to deliver original concepts, an engineer who’s determined to build high-performance platforms, or a customer care professional who will personalise our service every step of the way. Our unrivalled energy, innovative insights and exceptional work environments will activate your full potential. Join us to unlock a world of new possibilities – for you and the future of sports and gaming.

 **Job Description**

As an SDE III, you'll bring your engineering depth into a new way of working. You won't just write code — you'll specify, orchestrate, validate, and ship with AI as your primary collaborator. You'll work in a small, mission-driven cross-functional team called a pod — three functions (Product, Engineer, Quality) with high agency, shared ownership, and no hand-offs.

Reporting to the Tech Lead, you'll join the Product & Technology Team. Are you ready to be part of a team that's redefining how software gets built in an AI Native setup?

**What You Will Do**

* Deliver against the pod's mission — own the full software delivery lifecycle including quality, from design through production and measurement.
* Operate in continuous flow (Kanban) — pull work, respect WIP limits, ship daily.
* Use AI agents as your primary delivery mechanism — code generation, testing, spec writing, deployment.
* Design, build, and debug software across backend and frontend with distributed systems awareness.
* Evaluate and tune agent workflows — steering docs, prompts, rules, skills. You improve the tools you use.
* Write clean, well-tested code and take ownership of quality end-to-end.
* Act as the initial on-call responder, ensuring health and stability of deployed applications.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to shared tooling, knowledge bases, and the agent foundation kit.

Engineering Mindset — What We Look For

We assess every candidate across six core dimensions:

* **AI Fluency:** AI is the primary way we engineer. Prompt, evaluate, and iterate. Manual coding is a deliberate choice, not the default.
* **Cross-Functional Versatility:** "That's not my area" doesn't exist. Contribute beyond your discipline, share knowledge openly, and communicate clearly across different formats.
* **Customer and Value Awareness:** Ask "why" and "for whom" before "how." Understand the bigger business context while still being able to zoom in and trace a bug. Map dependencies before you build.
* **Craft:** Apply SOLID principles, DRY, separation of concerns, and observability by default. Write clean, maintainable code with the right level of testing. Treat CI/CD as standard engineering practice, whether the code is written by a human or an AI agent.
* **Technical Curiosity:** Build a prototype, experiment, and try to break it before relying solely on documentation. Stay curious about how things work and continuously explore better approaches.
* **Agency & Entrepreneurship:** Don't wait for permission. Take ownership of outcomes end-to-end, enable others to succeed, challenge the status quo, and proactively look for ways to create value.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Strong proficiency in at least one of the following: Java/Spring Boot, Python, .NET, Go, or Angular, …

**Key Responsibilities**

**Must Have**

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, Amazon, Selection Monitoring
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon’s Selection Monitoring team is responsible for making the biggest catalog on the planet even bigger. Our systems process billions of products to algorithmically find products not already sold on Amazon and programmatically add them to the Amazon catalog. We apply parallel processing, machine learning and deep learning algorithms to evaluate products and brands in order to identify and prioritize products and brands to be added to Amazon’s catalog. The datasets produced by our team are used by teams across Amazon to improve: product information, search and discoverability, pricing, and delivery experience. Our work involves building state-of-the-art Information Retrieval (IR) systems to mine the web and automatically create structured entities from un-structure/semi-structured data. We constantly stretch the boundaries of large scale distributed systems, Elastic Computing, Big Data, and SOA technologies to tackle challenges at Amazon’s global scale.  
  
Come join us in our journey to make everything – and yes, we do mean \*everything\* – that anyone wants to buy, available on Amazon!  
  
We are looking for SDEs with strong technical knowledge, established background in engineering large scale software systems, and passion for solving challenging problems. The role demands a high-performing and flexible candidate who can take responsibility for success of the system and drive solutions from design to coding, testing, and deployment, to achieve results in a fast paced environment.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Work with senior Engineers to drive the technical and architectural vision of Selection Monitoring’s External E-commerce source discovery and enrichment.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.
 In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes.
 This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.
 
 What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.
 Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it.
 Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims.
 Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions.
 Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why.
 What we're looking for You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).
 You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing.
 Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans.
 You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.
